events.title: Clancestry Festival
events.description: A multidisciplinary celebration of First Nations arts, featuring contemporary performances, installations, and cultural exchanges. The festival offers an immersive look at Indigenous history and storytelling within an accessible public space.

events.title: Gunawarra Re-Creation
events.description: An experimental theatre piece by ILBIJERRI Theatre Company exploring identity and connection to land through performance. Expect highly artistic, narrative-driven storytelling that challenges traditional performance structures.

events.title: Saturday Double Feature comedy show
events.location: The Sit Down Comedy Club, Brisbane
events.description: An evening of stand-up comedy featuring multiple local and touring performers. Provides a relaxed atmosphere for enjoying live performance art and observational humour.
